CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2608 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head d0d04b62b047d1839d20f8a4f76391d391f691af. Bus nonce: ac2d8a4fe92e5d7f3bccb826ff5505d2. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin d0d04b62b047d1839d20f8a4f76391d391f691af`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge d0d04b62b047d1839d20f8a4f76391d391f691af` or `Fix review: blocked d0d04b62b047d1839d20f8a4f76391d391f691af <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: ac2d8a4fe92e5d7f3bccb826ff5505d2`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `d0d04b62b047d1839d20f8a4f76391d391f691af` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2608 d0d04b62b047d1839d20f8a4f76391d391f691af") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2608-ac2d8a4f`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Fix reviewer for roster sync PR #2608 (group R10-ROSTER, branch fix/audit-r10-roster-12) at head d0d04b62b047d1839d20f8a4f76391d391f691af. It carries roster tip aa38bdd5f65ce4327c6def865107d17864bf7926 onto main 6c8903a44, plus its delivery row. Follow dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md. PREPR_SKIP_CLOSURES=1.
Required:
- The roster diff against origin/main must be exactly the eight ops `git rev-list 33138bc2f..aa38bdd5f` lists, and nothing else:
  - 459ef684a: append-group R10-RCA-INSTALL-RATELIMIT;
  - 9326f8a4e: carry to R10-FLY-GH-READ-RETRY;
  - d9f33a0f2: carry to R10-CI-LAYOUT-P2;
  - 2a64d2b5e: append-group R10-RECORD-API-BUDGET;
  - 7ab485ae9: append-group R10-NIGHTLY-HB-RESPAWN (decision O-4, from review/2605 f00094d17);
  - 9619aa9b1: R10-RECORD-API-BUDGET's brief edit, making O-1 conditional on M0's measured limit (from review/2606 3f3e5bda1);
  - 8a64c46d2 and aa38bdd5f: two carries to R10-RECORD-API-BUDGET from review/2606.
- Check each text against its source: `git fetch origin review/2605 review/2606 handoff-body/r10-rca-install-ratelimit`. In particular, no brief may still state the 1,000/hr bucket as fact.
- Judge O-4: does R10-NIGHTLY-HB-RESPAWN keep the heartbeat check's power? Judge O-1 as conditional.
- node tools/policy/brief_lint.mjs at the head gives 0 errors. carry_audit.py check over the body gives 0 unrouted. Every Carry in your verdict names a live group.
- Re-measure every figure (151 groups; the delta of 8). git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main d0d04b62b047d1839d20f8a4f76391d391f691af must be clean. Read check-runs. Rate-limit reds are external. nightly-status and delivery-status are not required.
- ev/HEAD.txt holds the full head, and VERDICT carries bus-nonce: ac2d8a4fe92e5d7f3bccb826ff5505d2. No /Users/ or /private/ path may appear in VERDICT.md or ev/.
